integrity: All assumptions and the exact threshold equalities are explicit; exact checker is a finite corroboration, not an infinite-time proof. All limits use an analytical variance contraction.
scientific_limitations: The result covers only three labeled agents on a complete graph, fixed positive node-first sampling weights, maximal equal compromise, strict confidence inequality, and normalized initial opinions (0,b,1). No general large-population claim or publication-priority guarantee.
title: Sharp three-person consensus windows under activity-weighted bounded confidence
